description: Inspect the Mandarin word or pattern at a Unicode code-point offset in the exact supplied passage. Returns MTW’s contextual word card with expected pinyin, meaning status, parts and offered alternatives. Count Unicode code points, not UTF-16 units; preserve the original passage. A null card means no applicable Mandarin target. Does not save or grade learning.

offset.description: Zero-based Unicode code-point position in the original text.

text.description: Exact original Mandarin passage, including punctuation and whitespace; at most 4,096 Unicode code points. Do not translate or rewrite it.

name: inspect_mandarin_word
title: Understand a word in its sentence
